detail.title: Parking Space Detection Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC414-PH5B-F2 Parking Space Detection Camera Key Points • High Sensitivity and Clarity: HD 4MP camera with 1/3"" CMOS, suitable for environment with low illumination • Advanced Multi-Spot Detection: 1 lenses with up to 99.5% recognition accuracy. Simultaneously detecting up to 3 parking spaces. • Easy deployment: Network wiring with easy connection, installation, and maintenance. • Robust Connectivity: 1 RS-485 for external indicators, 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet Port, H.264, H.265, and MJPEG flexible coding, PoE power supply and 12 VDC. • Built-in LED: 7 indicator lights colors, adjustable according to parking space type (charging spaces, handicapped spaces, etc.). • PON Support: Suitable for long-distance power supply, reducing wiring costs. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Basic.Parking Space Indicator: 1, 7 customizable colors (red, yellow, blue, green, cyan, white, and pink)
Basic.Image Resolution: 2688 (H) × 1520 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)
Basic.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 1743 kbps–13946 kbps H.265: 1743 kbps–13946 kbps MJPEG: 5230 kbps–41838 kbps
Basic.Exposure Mode: Auto; Manual (select from shutter values or customize shutter range)

Function.Security: Authorized username and password, MAC address binding, HTTPS encryption, IEEE 802.1x, and network access control
Function.OSD Overlay: Time, address, parking space No., parking space status, plate number, vehicle model, vehicle logo and color
Function.Alarm Event: Illegal access, security error and other events
Function.Image Tampering Prevention: Verifies watermarks in videos and images
Function.Network Protocol: TCP/IP; HTTP; DHCP; RTSP; NTP; HTTPS

Intelligence.Vehicle Recognition: Recognizes vehicle model, logo, color, and plate number, and collects metadata for unlicensed vehicles. Vehicle recognition rate is over 99.5% and plate recognition rate is over 99%
Intelligence.Parking Space Status Detection: Yes, the indicator color is customizable
Intelligence.Illegal Parking Detection: Detects illegal parking events including vehicle occupies two parking spaces, non-allowlist vehicle occupies parking space, and small vehicle parked in large vehicle's space.

Port.Network Port: 2 × RJ-45 Ethernet ports, 100 M network transmission
Port.Power Output: 12 VDC ± 10% voltage output, ≤1 A current output
